heard_on_the_hill.headline: Moolenaar urges Pentagon to flag 58 Chinese universities
heard_on_the_hill.body: House Select Committee on China Chairman John Moolenaar, in a letter to Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth, urged designation of 58 Chinese universities and 62 technology labs as national security threats, SCMP reported. He also called on the Pentagon to update its list of PLA-linked institutions and foreign talent-recruitment programs; Beijing called the request Cold War-style overreach.

heard_on_the_hill.headline: ASML says proposed Match Act curbs would backfire
heard_on_the_hill.body: ASML's chief financial officer said proposed U.S. legislation restricting the Dutch firm's sales of deep ultraviolet lithography equipment to China would be 'counterproductive,' Reuters reported.
